question: Where should metal-born and stone-born items be offered in worship?
premises: A metal-born item is to be offered at the door.
A stone-born item is to be offered in the enclosure.
The two materials have distinct placement locations.
inference: Therefore metal-born items should be offered at the door and stone-born items in the enclosure.
plain_english: One should offer the metal-made item at the door, but the stone-made item in the surrounding enclosure.
